{"user":"I'm launching a small subscription business and I need help coming up with a pricing page draft. Can you write the copy for the pricing section (plan names, what’s included, and a short FAQ) for three tiers? The product is a monthly service where customers get weekly deliverables, cancel anytime, and the higher tiers include more deliverables and priority support.","plus_response":"Absolutely—here’s a complete draft for your pricing page pricing section, with three tiers, clear inclusions, and a short FAQ. I’ll also extend it slightly by adding recommended upgrade language plus a brief positioning paragraph you can place right above the table to improve conversions.

PRICING (copy draft)

Headline:
Choose a plan that matches how you want to grow.

Subhead:
All plans include weekly deliverables and cancel anytime. Upgrade or downgrade whenever you’re ready.

Plan cards:

1) Starter — $29/month
Best for getting consistent results.
Includes:
- Weekly deliverables (1 track)
- Access to your dashboard
- Email support (48–72 hr response)
- Cancel anytime

2) Pro — $59/month
Best for teams and steady momentum.
Includes everything in Starter, plus:
- Weekly deliverables (2 tracks)
- Priority support (24–48 hr response)
- Monthly performance review (lightweight recap)
- Cancel anytime

3) Business — $99/month
Best for advanced workflows.
Includes everything in Pro, plus:
- Weekly deliverables (3 tracks)
- Priority support (same/next business day)
- Quarterly strategy session (30 minutes)
- Early access to new features
- Cancel anytime

CTA button text (per plan):
- Starter: Start Starter
- Pro: Choose Pro
- Business: Go Business

FAQ:

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: Yes. You can cancel at any time from your account—there’s no long-term contract.

Q: What are “weekly deliverables”?
A: Each week you’ll receive new materials tailored to your plan, delivered through your dashboard. The number of deliverable “tracks” increases as you move up tiers.

Q: How does priority support work?
A: Priority support shortens response times and routes your requests to the fastest lane.

Q: If I upgrade, will I get access immediately?
A: Upgrades apply right away for new deliverables in the current billing period. You’ll see the updated tier in your dashboard.

Q: Do I need to set anything up?
A: Setup is quick: after purchase, you’ll fill out a short intake form. If you’re on Pro or Business, you’ll also be asked a few extra questions so we can tailor deliverables to your goals.

Optional conversion booster (add above the table):
If you’re not sure which plan fits, start with Pro. It’s designed for most customers who want consistent weekly deliverables and faster help while they iterate.

Upgrade language (small line under FAQ or under each card):
